title: Story Saver & Story Downloader
summary: Easily save your videos and photos to your device with Story Saver
description:
The description of Story Saver

🔥 Easily save your videos, reels and photos to your phone on Instagram with the Story Saver for Instagram app.

All post types are supported. You can view and save many things such as IGTV, reels, story, profile pictures, highlights, DP. Download video and photo with their caption and tagged users, tags, location etc.

The Story Downloader for Instagram app is easy to use and story saver will help you to store insta story in your phone. You can also store reels and videos easily.

🔥 Download and save video, reels, IGTV video and photos from Instagram easily.
🔥 Share photo and video to any social media app.
🔥 View stories without letting them know.
🔥 It supports multiple type post download.
🔥 Search accounts and browse stories.
🔥 View and copy post caption and tags.
🔥 Download within a single click.
🔥 Repost to Instagram quickly.

A Single App has all Instagram media types downloader in 2021.

Profile Picture Saver for IG
The simplest way to download photos from Instagram. You can download everything, including highlight cover photos and profile pictures.

Instagram Post Downloader
It is now easy to download any Instagram post you want to share save in your device. Copy Instagram post link and paste it into the app and start downloading.

Insta Story Download
Since Stories disappear after 24 hours, it is easy to download and store story to your phone. If you want, you can choose one by one or choose all of them.

Highlight Downloader
Highlight download feature is one of the most used functions of the application. You can save highlight videos to your device.

Video Downloader for Instagram
Any video you like and wish to save on your device with a click. Download videos and share them from any app whenever you want.

IGTV Video Download
IGTV videos are of very big videos. Downloading them is mostly difficult. Easily download long IGTV videos to your phone with the fast download manager.

Instagram Reels Video Downloader
Instagram's new short video type reels videos can also be downloaded in this app. All you have to do is share the reels videos link with this app and click on Download button

Get ready to use the best Instagram download manager of 2020.
